_comment: config:link_rules example — upload via: wrangler kv:key put --binding=TODO_CACHE 'config:link_rules' "$(cat config-examples/link-rules.json)"
_comment2: Each rule's 'pattern' is a JS RegExp source string. $1, $2, … in templates (url_template, display_template, external_id_template) refer to capture groups.
_comment3: Microsoft To Do allows exactly ONE linked resource per task. The engine therefore creates at most one: rules are evaluated in array order and the FIRST matching rule wins (array order = priority; title is matched before body). If the task already has any linked resource, the engine skips rather than replacing it.
_comment4: external_id_template sets the linked resource's externalId. To Do only renders a link as a clickable row when it carries an externalId, so populate it (it defaults to the matched text when omitted).

rules._comment: Jira tickets: matches PROJ-1234 in title or body
Autotask PSA tickets like T20240101.1234 — replace <your-zone> with your Autotask server zone (e.g. ww3, ww4, ww14; check your login URL)
